messages.subject: Re: Mountain Lion Installation Issue (R 2.15.1, Rattle 2.6.21)
parts:
Hi Graham,

I did some troubleshooting and got rattle to work on Mountain Lion!  

I also found some interesting things and a possible rattle bug as well...

Interesting Point #1
The AT&T website no longer hosts the GTK 2.18.5 framework (which is at a URL that rattle looks for during rattle installation).  The file is now at this URL:
http://www.stats.ox.ac.uk/pub/R/GTK_2.18.5-X11.pkg

Interesting Point #2
Apple's new "Mountain Lion" OS does not include X11 (XQuartz) and the XQuartz application will need to be downloaded and installed in order for rattle to work properly.  It can be downloaded at:
http://xquartz.macosforge.org/landing/

Interesting Point #3
There is a possible bug that occurs during the rattle() function call (in the R console).  Here is how I reproduced it:

First, open R on Mountain Lion and enter the following in the console:

> rattle()

Then, notice the following errors in the R console after the rattle GUI opens:

Then, close the rattle GUI (but do not close the R console).

Then, open the rattle GUI once again with the following call in the R console:

> rattle()

Now, notice how there are no console at all.  Seems like a bug...

Hi Ray and Graham, 

First, thanks for posting this, Ray - I've been struggling with installing rattle on Mountain Lion and I think this helps a lot. 

I tried to install the GTK_2.18.5-X11 package (after installing XQuartz, as you recommended). I received the following warnings:

> install.packages("GTK_2.18.5-X11.pkg",repos="http://www.stats.ox.ac.uk/pub/R/", type="source")

Warning: unable to access index for repository http://www.stats.ox.ac.uk/pub/R/src/contrib

Warning message:

package ‘GTK_2.18.5-X11.pkg’ is not available (for R version 2.15.1) 


I've never installed a package from source before, so perhaps there is an easy workaround for these two issues? I'd appreciate your help.


Best wishes, 

Barbara

messages.author: 5670963b5e6c2b8d
messages.subject: Re: Mountain Lion Installation Issue (R 2.15.1, Rattle 2.6.21)
parts:
Hi Barbara,

I don't think the install.packages() function will work in this case because a PKG file is a Mac Application package file (not an R Package file).

I would install the GTK PKG file without using R at all.  Just install it by clicking it in your Downloads Folder.

Shutdown R and click the link below to download it:

http://www.stats.ox.ac.uk/pub/R/GTK_2.18.5-X11.pkg

Then, go into your Downloads folder and install the PKG file by clicking it.  Mountain Lion may say something like "unable to install because this is not from a known vendor...".  This feature is called "GateKeeper" in Mountain Lion and prevents viruses, etc...

If you get this GateKeeper message, you can bypass GateKeeper it by "control-clicking" on the PKG file (inside your Downloads folder).  Here is more info on GateKeeper:

http://support.apple.com/kb/HT5290

- Ray
